scenes.text: A ratio compares quantities in the same order; 2:3 means two units of the first for every three of the second.
Simplify the ratio 8:10. The answer is 4:5. Divide both parts by the common factor. The ratio is 4:5.
A bead string during a library project has 9 blue and 6 yellow beads. What is the simplified blue:yellow ratio? Pause to choose and explain.
A bead string during a library project has 9 blue and 6 yellow beads. What is the simplified blue:yellow ratio? The answer is 3:2. Divide both parts by the common factor. The ratio is 3:2.
